चिकित्सा विषय: ब्रेन स्ट्रोक क्या होता है और इसके चेतावनी संकेत क्या हैं?

हिंदी में व्याख्या:
model_response: ब्रेन स्ट्रोक (Cerebrovascular accident; CVA), या stroke, brain attack, or "brain damage" is a neurological event that occurs when the blood supply to all or part of the brain is interrupted or reduced, as by blockage or rupture of a blood vessel. A stroke may be caused by a clot formed on site in an artery within the brain (ischemic stroke); hemorrhagic stroke, i.e., bleeding into or around the brain from a burst blood vessel; subarachnoid hemorrhage, which involves bleeding under the arachnoid mater and often accompanies ruptured cerebral aneurysms; intracerebral hemorrhage, which results in bleeding directly into the brain tissue itself; or embolism, where clots originating elsewhere travel through the bloodstream until they reach smaller arteries in the brain.
